mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WORK_LOG (log_id, user_id, job_id, work_date, start_time, end_time, fatigue, estimated_income, status) VALUES (#{logId}, #{userId}, #{jobId}, #{workDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{fatigue}, #{estimatedIncome}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE WORK_LOG SET work_date = #{workDate}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, fatigue = #{fatigue}, estimated_income = #{estimatedIncome}, status = #{status} WHERE log_id = #{logId}
